lineageflow_real_forward.D-004_defect: The checkpoint-compat shim registered a bare core module with no __path__, shadowing vendored upstream core/ -> _try_import_lineageflow_upstream() returned None -> adapter integrated an all-zero velocity field. Every 'real-ckpt' run before the fix was zero-field.
lineageflow_real_forward.D-004_fix: bf66aa4 - give the fabricated core a __path__ pointing at data/lineageflow_upstream/core/ when present. _model becomes models.model.LineageFlowClassifier; velocity non-zero.
lineageflow_real_forward.D-004_remeasure: docs/audit/r1-d004-remeasure.md - with the real field live, the framework arm collapsed to 0 hits on all 3 seeds (d_pooled=-0.4013). Root cause: _build_initial_state_and_condition accepts a seed it never uses -> record-identical x0; only the restart perturbation carried per-record entropy, and it was too weak once the deterministic real field was live.
lineageflow_real_forward.D-004b_fix: 1264cec - on the real-classifier path, the restart fresh state is a per-record random simplex softmax(randn(L, AA_VOCAB)) (Wave-41 tool noise convention). Synthetic path byte-unchanged (D.4 preserved). Tests added.

assessment.question: Can this be published in a CAS Tier-1 / Q1 journal (TNNLS)?
assessment.verdict: Plausible, but sitting on the decision boundary. The contribution type (portable training-free re-inference framework + typed contracts + hash-chained ledger + byte-stable reproducibility + 2 conditional theorems + mechanism-isolating evidence) is exactly what TNNLS publishes; the reproducibility infrastructure is above the venue norm. The gating risk is the empirical axis, not the framework.
strong_axes: Framework + reproducibility infrastructure (D.4 byte-stable, SHA-256 ledger, per-cell recipes, master verifier) - Tier-1 grade.
Large, significant effects where the mechanism is load-bearing (R6 hard-tier d_z=+1.189; R6 scPerp cluster-robust d_z=-4.019; R5c smoke d_z=-13.18; K4/K5 cluster-robust d_z=+0.84/+1.12).
Head-to-head: FlowA beats vanilla + Fast-DLLM + AB-Cache + LeDiFlow on R6 both metrics x both NFE (16-cell Table B Bonferroni-sig).
Two theorems with proofs + honest scope (Wave 372 retracted the parts that did not follow).
The conditional/regression cells form a coherent 'headroom' story, not noise.
gating_risks: R1/R3 flagship protein/molecule cells are single-seed/projected (R1 now improved by D-004b; R3 still env-blocked).
Baseline fairness (GAP-12): straw-man baseline is the classic framework-paper death.
The conditional/regression cluster needs one clean boundary law, not per-cell excuses.
Meta-content density: 11 pages carry a lot of audit/disclosure prose; a reviewer may read it as engineering-heavy / science-thin.
D-004b win is not yet mechanism-attributed (init vs restart-blend confound).
decision_variables: How R1 (D-004b attribution) and R3 (N=1000 actual) real-ckpt runs land.
Whether the conditional evidence converges into one boundary law.
Whether the framework framing survives the 'conditional wins' critique.
